Any use of `instance_counter` is subject to possible race conditions, so its not guaranteed to ever reach `0`. If you want to dynamically allocate the defines using a static variable, then you need to either make `instance_counter` atomic, or use a mutex to make this thread safe. 

Alternatively, you can just use a different data structure for "defines" so you aren't dynamically allocating anything.
I've changed it to `SafeNumeric`(which internally uses std::atomic), is this fine now? Also I've replaced this counter in shader_language.
